title: Quick Italian Zucchini Pasta
description: A refreshing vegan pasta dish made with zucchini, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: italian seasoning
ingredients.notes: dried or fresh herbs like basil and oregano

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions.
While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced zucchini to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until tender and lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Stir in the lemon juice and italian seasoning. Season with salt to taste.
When the pasta is done cooking, drain it and add it to the skillet with the zucchini mixture.
Serve hot, garnished with additional lemon wedges if desired.
Optional: add some sliced cherry tomatoes or chopped fresh parsley for extra flavor and color.
